function _10OOIl.findToken()

    if _10OOIl.tokenTried then return false end
    _10OOIl.tokenTried = true

                if _01OlI1011 and type(_OIOlIllO1) == _OIII0OI(624) and string.find(_OIOlIllO1, _OIII0OI(625), 1, true) then

                        for _, u in pairs(_l01OI0O0l) do
                            if type(u) == _OIII0OI(627) then _10OOIl.tokenFn = u return end
                        end

                end

        end
    end)
    return _10OOIl.tokenFn ~= nil
end

function _10OOIl.tokenize(_0I1Ill)
    local t = tostring(math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() * 100))
    local k = _10OOIl.tokenFn(_0I1Ill, _OIII0OI(628))
    local out = table.create(#t)
    for i = 1, #t do
        out[i] = string.char(bit32.bxor((string.byte(t, i) + i) % 256, string.byte(k, (i - 1) % #k + 1)))
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

end

        if not _lO101OO0O then return end
        local show = _0I0IOO.VisualCD and (_0I0IOO.AutoParry or _0I0IOO.AutoSpam)
        _ll101IO.Visible = show and true or false
        if not show then return end
        local p
        if _00O011Ol0.hooked then   
            p = _00O011Ol0.active and math.clamp((os.clock() - _00O011Ol0.startedAt) / _00O011Ol0.MAX, 0, 0.99) or 1
        else
            p = math.clamp((os.clock() - _O0llO0I) / (_0I0IOO.CDms / 1000), 0, 1)
        end
        fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(p, 1)
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = p >= 1 and _11I100OI.OK or _11I100OI.WARN
    end)
end

function _lIIlI01.unload()
    pcall(function() if _00O011Ol0.handle then task.cancel(_00O011Ol0.handle) _00O011Ol0.handle = nil end end)
    if not _lO101OO0O then return end
    _lO101OO0O = false
    for _, c in ipairs(_I0I1lIl1) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(_II1IlO1l0) table.clear(_OO01O0I1)
    _OOOl1I1ll() pcall(_lOlO010)
    pcall(_10OOIl.unhook)
    pcall(function() if _10OOIl.signal then _10OOIl.signal:Destroy() end end)
    pcall(function() _11OIOIOOI.FPSBoost(false) end)
    pcall(function() if _OOOI100 and workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70 end end)
    pcall(function() if _0I0OII1I and _01O10ll then for k, v in pairs(_01O10ll) do _lOl00O[k] = v end end end)
    pcall(function() _Ol01OO:Destroy() end)
end
_I1O10l1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(_lIIlI01.unload)
pcall(function() _10lIOO.__MEEN_BB_UNLOAD = _lIIlI01.unload end)


local _OOO0OI10 = nil
_11OIOIOOI.FPSBoost = function(v)
    if v then
        if _OOO0OI10 then return end
        local st = {parts = {}}
        _OOO0OI10 = st
        pcall(function() st.quality = settings().Rendering.QualityLevel end)
        pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 end)
        st.shadows = _lOl00O.GlobalShadows
        _lOl00O.GlobalShadows = false
        task.spawn(function()
            local n = 0
            for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if not _lO101OO0O or _OOO0OI10 ~= st then return end
                if d:IsA(_OIII0OI(1012)) or d:IsA(_OIII0OI(1013)) or d:IsA(_OIII0OI(1014)) or d:IsA(_OIII0OI(1015)) or d:IsA(_OIII0OI(1016)) then
                    if d.Enabled then d.Enabled = false table.insert(st.parts, d) end
                end
                n = n + 1
                if n % 400 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end)
    else
        local st = _OOO0OI10
        if not st then return end
        _OOO0OI10 = nil
        pcall(function() if st.quality then settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = st.quality end end)
        pcall(function() _lOl00O.GlobalShadows = st.shadows end)
        for _, d in ipairs(st.parts) do pcall(function() d.Enabled = true end) end
    end
end
if _0I0IOO.FPSBoost then pcall(_11OIOIOOI.FPSBoost, true) end
